features: STORAGE CAPACITY: 512GB external solid-state storage for documents, photos, videos and project files. Available formatted capacity may be lower than the stated capacity.
USB-C CONNECTION: Connect to a compatible computer using the included USB-C to USB-C cable.
PORTABLE DESIGN: A compact external drive for an everyday workspace or travel setup.
COMPATIBILITY: Check your computer's USB port, operating system and file-system support before use. Transfer performance varies with the host system, cable and files.
